lesson.title: A breakout is a question; the retest is the answer
lesson.text: NIFTY 50 broke above the 30-min OR high (25,465) at 11:00 AM and then closed back below it — a false breakout. Buying calls on that candle would have meant buying the top. Waiting for a 15-min close and a retest that HOLDS keeps you out of these traps.
